jobs.title: Client Solutions Associate, San Francisco
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Office Hours is an on-demand expert network that connects leading organizations with trusted experts across various knowledge domains. Experts earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, projects, and AI model training. Our platform handles the complexities behind the scenes— screening, compliance, scheduling, and payments—so knowledge sharing stays focused on meaningful insights and real impact.

We’re a hyper-growth and profitable company, quickly expanding our expert network, launching new offices, and new products. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore. Our customers include the fastest-growing digital health companies, technology companies, institutional investment firms, consulting firms and AI Labs. We are backed by top marketplace investors and operators of companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, Affirm.

What we believe

Human knowledge is the world’s most valuable asset. And yet, despite being more interconnected than ever, most knowledge still remains stuck in our heads, inaccessible and underutilized. Our vision is to make human knowledge easily accessible and infinitely scalable by building tools for the new age knowledge economy.

About the role

Our Client Solutions team is the front line for finding the right experts for our clients. As a Client Solutions Associate, you will be directly responsible for growing our network and scaling our impact by connecting our clients to the right subject matter experts, who will then share their knowledge through qualitative interviews.

This role is fast-paced and no day is the same. You will need to be hard-working, flexible, with strong client-facing communication skills. You will be part of creating and improving processes to help us do better work every day. You will work alongside our product and engineering team to translate client feedback into product improvements.

We are looking for candidates that are excited to face the successes and challenges of growing a business and developing a loyal base of users.

What you'll do

Though no day is the same as a CSA, you can expect the job to involve:

  • Client-Expert Connections: You'll identify and match experts to clients for interview-based research needs, continuously communicating with clients and experts to track the progress of these connections to ensure high-quality outcomes and client satisfaction.

  • Project Creation & Ownership: Manage your clients’ research projects, from understanding their goals to recruiting and scheduling the right experts for them. Recruiting experts involves using our internal network and external channels like social media, meticulously reviewing professional profiles, reaching out to potential experts, and strategically matching them to specific project requirements.

  • Project Performance Tracking: Monitor client and expert feedback on interviews to 1) drive successful research for our clients and 2) ensure our network has only high-quality, engaged experts.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Share insights from client and expert interactions to help product and engineering teams continuously refine the Office Hours online platform. Your frontline experience will provide critical input for user experience improvements.

This role demands strategic thinking, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to solving projects.

What you bring

  • You are not afraid of ambitious goals

  • You are a great communicator

  • You are an optimist with a growth mindset

  • You thrive when you truly own something

  • You are an independent problem-solver

  • 0-2 years of professional work experience

Bonus Experience

  • Prior experience working at a startup

  • Prior experience in a customer success role

  • Strong understanding of various professional industries and roles

Benefits + perks

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

  • Paid time off policy, along with company holidays

  • Annual company off-sites (Tahoe, Mendocino, Mexico City, San Diego, Park City)

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Paid parental leave (12 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, and birthing parents get 8–10 additional weeks of paid recovery leave)

Join our team and help everyone realize the true power of what they know!

Pay Transparency Notice:

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits

US-based pay range: The total target compensation for this role* ranges from $78k to $97k, comprising a base salary of $72k to $88k plus an uncapped performance bonus. Final compensation is determined by experience and skill level.

*This role is posted across two levels, Client Solutions Associate and Senior Client Solutions Associate. Your title and compensation will be set based on your experience and demonstrated skills during the interview process.

This is a hybrid role, in our San Francisco office 2-3 times per week.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that some candidates, especially underrepresented groups such as women and people of color, are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Office Hours we believe in building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You could still be the right candidate for this or other roles at Office Hours!

  • Strong executor who enjoys owning complex projects end-to-end.

  • Comfortable working with demanding, technical customers.

  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused, especially in regulated environments.

jobs.location: San Francisco, NYC, or Fully Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Office Hours is an on-demand consulting platform that connects leading organizations with trusted experts across various domains. Experts earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, projects, and AI model training. Our platform handles the complexities behind the scenes, screening, compliance, scheduling, and payments, so knowledge sharing stays focused on meaningful insights and real impact.

We’re a hyper-growth, profitable company, quickly expanding our expert network, launching new offices, and building new products. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore. Our customers include the fastest-growing digital health companies, technology companies, institutional investment firms, consulting firms, and AI Labs. We are backed by top marketplace investors and operators of companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, and Affirm.

What we believe

Human knowledge is the world’s most valuable asset. And yet, despite being more interconnected than ever, most knowledge still remains stuck in our heads, inaccessible and underutilized. Our vision is to make human knowledge easily accessible and infinitely scalable by building tools for the new age knowledge economy.

How we think about design

Design is foundational to Office Hours.

We believe quality comes from judgment, care, and attention to detail, especially when building complex systems. Speed matters, but not at the expense of coherence or craft. We aim to build products that feel clear, durable, and considered, not rushed or over-optimized.

We care deeply about visual design, typography, consistency, and restraint. We trust intuition alongside data, and we regularly ask whether something feels right, not just whether it ships or converts. We’d rather ship a smaller surface that feels finished than a larger one that doesn’t.

This role reports to the Head of Product, who has designed the platform end-to-end since the beginning and remains closely involved in product design.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with strong taste and experience shipping high-quality products in complex environments.

This role is suited for someone with 5+ years of experience who can own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from shaping problems to refining execution. You’ll work closely with product and engineering partners to design thoughtful, scalable experiences across a two-sided marketplace where trust, clarity, and quality matter.

You’ll be expected to set a high bar for craft, help guide decisions through design judgment, and raise the overall quality of the product through your work and influence.

What you'll do

  • Own and design end-to-end experiences across expert, client, and internal product surfaces.

  • Partner with product and engineering to define problems, explore solutions, and ship features thoughtfully.

  • Translate complex requirements into clear user flows, interactions, and visual systems.

  • Craft high-quality UI with strong attention to typography, spacing, hierarchy, and brand.

  • Prototype and iterate quickly, then refine designs to a consistently high polish.

  • Contribute to and evolve shared patterns, systems, and design foundations.

  • Help raise the design bar through critique, feedback, and example.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a related role.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong visual design, typography, and taste across shipped products.

  • Experience designing complex workflows, systems, or multi-surface products.

  • Strong fundamentals in interaction design, usability, and information hierarchy.

  • Comfort working closely with engineers and product partners from concept through launch.

  • Clear communication skills and a principled approach to design decisions.

  • A consistent track record of care, judgment, and quality in your work.

Strong command of visuals, typography, and brand sensibility is strongly preferred.

This role is a good fit if you already hold a high bar for craft and want to work in an environment where quality is expected, protected, and shared.

Experience with B2B products, marketplaces, or workflow-heavy tools is a plus.

Tools

Figma, Linear, Notion, Slack, Cursor/Claude, Excalidraw, PostHog, Metabase

Benefits + Perks

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Wellness and fitness stipend

  • Flexible vacation time and regular company holidays

  • Company retreats (Tahoe, Mendocino, Mexico City, San Diego, Park City)

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Paid parental leave (12 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, and birthing parents get 8–10 additional weeks of paid recovery leave)

Pay Transparency Notice

Full-time offers include salary, target equity, and benefits.

Pay range: $180,000–$200,000, based on experience and scope.

This is a hybrid role, ideally in our SF or NY office, 2-3 times per week

jobs.location: San Francisco, NYC, or Fully Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Office Hours is an on-demand marketplace for verified human knowledge. We connect leading organizations with trusted experts who earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, research, and AI model training.

We're a fast-growing, profitable company building new ways for people and AI agents to access human expertise. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore, and backed by leading marketplace investors and operators from companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, Pinterest, and Affirm.

What we believe

Human knowledge is the world's most valuable asset. Yet most of it remains inaccessible and underutilized.

We're building a world where anyone can get paid for what they know, and anyone can access trusted human expertise on demand. We believe great products can make this exchange effortless, creating more opportunities for experts and more valuable answers for the people who need them.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager, Growth who combines exceptional creativity with strong analytical instincts. We're open to candidates at both the Product Manager and Senior Product Manager levels, and care more about demonstrated ability, impact, and potential than years of experience or previous titles.

You'll help more people discover Office Hours, experience its value, and keep coming back. Initially, you'll focus on growing engagement across our expert network, improving everything from acquisition and onboarding to activation, retention, and repeat earning opportunities. Over time, your work may extend across both sides of our marketplace.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves understanding why people behave the way they do, identifying opportunities to accelerate growth, and turning ideas into measurable results. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, and operations to dig into data, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship improvements that move the business forward.

What you'll do

  • Find opportunities for growth. Analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and cohort data to identify friction, uncover insights, and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Experiment relentlessly. Develop creative hypotheses, design experiments, measure results, and iterate quickly. Know when to run a rigorous A/B test and when a simpler experiment can help you learn faster.

  • Improve activation and engagement. Help more experts successfully onboard, discover relevant opportunities, earn their first dollar, and return regularly.

  • Build compounding growth loops. Explore new ways to drive acquisition, referrals, engagement, retention, and reactivation through product experiences that create lasting value.

  • Turn insights into shipped products. Work closely with engineering and design to prototype, build, launch, and refine solutions, balancing speed with a high standard for product quality.

  • Own outcomes, not output. Define clear success metrics, build dashboards, track performance, and use what you learn to continuously improve the product and our growth strategy.

  • Collaborate across the business. Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Operations to connect growth initiatives with our broader company goals.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, growth, analytics, engineering, or a related field. We care more about demonstrated ability and impact than a specific career path.

  • Creative and quantitative instincts. You enjoy finding unconventional solutions to difficult problems and using data to understand whether they work.

  • A scientific mindset. You're naturally curious, comfortable forming and testing hypotheses, and willing to change your mind when the evidence suggests a better approach.

  • Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable working with funnels, conversion rates, cohorts, and product analytics tools, and can independently investigate problems using data.

  • A bias toward action. You're resourceful, proactive, and comfortable taking ideas from early exploration through execution without waiting for perfect information.

  • Strong product judgment. You care about the people using your product and understand that sustainable growth comes from delivering genuine value, not simply optimizing metrics.

  • Clear communication and collaboration. You can explain complex problems simply, bring people together around a solution, and take ownership of outcomes.

Bonus experience

  • Experience working on growth, activation, engagement, or retention at a consumer product, marketplace, or product-led software company.

  • Experience with experimentation platforms, SQL, PostHog, Metabase, or similar analytical tools.

  • Experience building products, prototypes, or side projects using AI-assisted development tools.

  • Entrepreneurial experience, whether founding a company, building an independent product, or leading a new initiative from scratch.

Benefits + perks

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

  • Flexible vacation time and company holidays

  • Annual company offsites

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Paid parental leave

Pay transparency notice

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is $160,000–$220,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and scope.

We're open to hiring at either the Product Manager or Senior Product Manager level and will calibrate title and compensation accordingly.

Office Hours is an on-demand marketplace for verified human knowledge. We connect leading organizations with trusted experts who earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, research, and AI model training.

We're a fast-growing, profitable company building new ways for people and AI agents to access human expertise. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore, and backed by leading marketplace investors and operators from companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, Pinterest, and Affirm.

What we believe

Human knowledge is the world's most valuable asset. Yet most of it remains inaccessible and underutilized.

We're building a world where anyone can get paid for what they know, and anyone can access trusted human expertise on demand. We believe great products can make this exchange effortless, creating more opportunities for experts and more valuable answers for the people who need them.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager with exceptional entrepreneurial drive, strong product judgment, and commercial instincts. We're open to candidates at both the Product Manager and Senior Product Manager levels, and care more about demonstrated ability, impact, and potential than years of experience or previous titles.

You'll help Office Hours discover, build, and bring new products to market. Initially, you'll focus on expanding how organizations access and use expert knowledge, exploring new customer needs, developing new product experiences, and turning promising opportunities into successful, growing businesses.

This is a hands-on, externally facing role for someone who loves building things from scratch. You'll work directly with prospective customers to uncover problems, pitch ideas, validate demand, and win early adopters. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and operations to turn those insights into products that customers love and are willing to pay for.

We're looking for someone ambitious, resourceful, and highly self-directed. Someone who sees an opportunity, takes ownership, and has the drive and discipline to make it happen.

What you'll do

  • Discover new opportunities. Work directly with customers and prospects to understand their needs, uncover unmet demand, and identify opportunities for new products and businesses.

  • Build products from zero to one. Turn ambiguous opportunities into compelling product concepts, rapidly prototype solutions, and work with engineering and design to bring them to market.

  • Win early customers. Pitch new ideas, recruit design partners, run pilots, and work directly with customers to validate demand and drive early adoption and revenue.

  • Find product-market fit. Develop hypotheses, test assumptions, gather feedback, and iterate quickly to discover what customers truly value and are willing to pay for.

  • Drive commercialization. Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations on positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies that help products gain traction.

  • Own outcomes, not output. Define clear success metrics, measure adoption and commercial performance, and use what you learn to determine where to invest, iterate, or change direction.

  • Drive execution end to end. Bring structure to ambiguous initiatives, coordinate cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and maintain momentum from initial exploration through launch and growth.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, entrepreneurship, consulting, engineering, business operations, or a related field. We care more about demonstrated ability and impact than a specific career path.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset. You're ambitious, self-motivated, and energized by building something from nothing. You take initiative, create momentum, and don't need someone telling you what to do next.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You enjoy talking to customers, understanding their businesses, pitching ideas, and finding opportunities to create and capture value.

  • Exceptional product judgment. You can identify meaningful customer problems, develop creative solutions, and translate ambiguous ideas into simple, compelling product experiences.

  • A bias toward action. You're resourceful, scrappy, and comfortable moving quickly with incomplete information. You'd rather test an idea in the real world than endlessly debate it.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills. You approach problems with structure and rigor, pay attention to details, and can manage complex initiatives without losing sight of what matters.

  • Clear communication and collaboration. You can explain complex ideas simply, build relationships with customers and colleagues, and bring people together to achieve ambitious outcomes.

Bonus experience

  • Experience launching new products, finding product-market fit, or building new businesses at an early-stage startup.

  • Experience with B2B software, developer platforms, APIs, AI products, or two-sided marketplaces.

  • Experience in customer development, enterprise sales, or partnerships.

  • Background in management consulting, investment banking, or another analytically rigorous environment, combined with a strong builder's mindset.

  • Experience building products, prototypes, or side projects using AI-assisted development tools.

Benefits + perks

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

  • Flexible vacation time and company holidays

  • Annual company offsites

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Paid parental leave

Pay transparency notice

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is $160,000–$220,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and scope.

We're open to hiring at either the Product Manager or Senior Product Manager level and will calibrate title and compensation accordingly.

jobs.title: Founding Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Office Hours is an on-demand expert network that connects leading organizations with trusted experts across various knowledge domains. Experts earn income by sharing their knowledge through advisory work, projects, and AI model training. Our platform handles the complexities behind the scenes— screening, compliance, scheduling, and payments—so knowledge sharing stays focused on meaningful insights and real impact.

We’re a hyper-growth and profitable company, quickly expanding our expert network, launching new offices, and new products. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in Brooklyn and Bangalore. Our customers include the fastest-growing digital health companies, technology companies, institutional investment firms, consulting firms and AI Labs. We are backed by top marketplace investors and operators of companies like DoorDash, Airbnb, Affirm.

What we believe

Human knowledge is the world’s most valuable asset. And yet, despite being more interconnected than ever, most knowledge still remains stuck in our heads, inaccessible and underutilized. Our vision is to make human knowledge easily accessible and infinitely scalable by building tools for the new age knowledge economy.

About the role

We're looking for a Founding Head of Marketing to build our marketing function from the ground up, setting the strategy and rolling up their sleeves to bring it to life. Reporting to and working directly with the CEO, this person will translate what we've built, what we believe, and where we're going into a compelling narrative that resonates with our market and builds momentum with clients and experts alike.

You'll own the full arc from strategy to execution: defining our messaging and positioning, building the assets and content that bring our story to life, developing the playbooks and campaigns that amplify it, and continuously learning from the market to sharpen our approach. As our first senior marketing leader, you'll establish not only what we say and how we go to market, but the foundation for how the marketing function operates and scales as the company grows.

The right person has been an early marketer at a high-growth, early-stage company and knows what it means to wear many hats. You're looking for a role where you can have an outsized impact on the trajectory of the business, and you're energized by the chance to build a new function from a blank slate and shape how it evolves as the company grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own positioning and product marketing. Partner closely with the CEO to sharpen our core narrative, including the "why Office Hours, why now" story, and translate it into a clear, consistent story across Sales, CS, Product, and the customer experience. Stay close to the market and competitive landscape, using what you know and learn to continuously sharpen how we position the company.

  • Develop core marketing and sales assets. Create and maintain the foundational materials that bring our positioning to life, including our master sales deck, ICP-specific one-pagers, pricing collateral, category overviews, and website content. Build them from the ground up and establish a cadence for keeping them sharp and current.

  • Build and run our content engine. Establish a consistent rhythm of high-quality content, from case studies and POV pieces to white papers, longer-form reports, and a company newsletter. Turn the ideas and insights already inside Office Hours, including expert conversations, proprietary data and frameworks, events, and more, into content that earns attention, builds credibility, and gives buyers something worth sharing internally.

  • Founder & CEO amplification. Develop the strategy for making our CEO and founder known for a distinct point of view on the future of knowledge work. Own our LinkedIn and social presence, ghostwrite and edit on a consistent cadence, and draw out their thinking so their reach compounds over time. Expand into earned and paid channels as the foundation takes shape.

  • Own field marketing and events. Lead our dinner series and other owned events end to end, from audience and guest strategy through invitations, execution, and follow-up. Initially, you'll be hands-on with every part of the motion. Over time, you'll codify what works and build the resources to scale it.

  • Build the marketing function. Start as a hands-on individual contributor and build the function around what works. As the company scales, determine where we need additional capabilities, hire and develop the team, and lead the marketers, creatives, agencies, and contractors who help us grow.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of marketing experience, including as an early marketer at an early-stage company. You've helped build a marketing function from the ground up and know how to operate without an established playbook, team, or infrastructure.

  • Deep product marketing expertise. You're fluent in positioning, messaging, segmentation, competitive strategy, and enablement, with a strong instinct for making complex offerings simple and compelling.

  • Experience in a B2B sales environment. You understand how enterprise buyers buy and know how to partner closely with Sales and CS to turn positioning into tools and content that help win, grow, and retain accounts.

  • Exceptional writing, at speed and at volume. You can move between buyer-facing messaging, long-form thought leadership, executive content, and social, and make each feel sharp, distinctive, and appropriate for the audience.

  • AI-forward execution. You use AI to increase the quality and volume of what you can produce, but never at the expense of your own thinking or your standard for the output. You know slop when you see it.

  • A builder's mindset. You can take raw inputs, form a point of view, and run with it, then build the thing yourself, whether it's a deck, one-pager, post, page, or campaign. You own the work from direction through delivery and hold a high bar for the output.

  • Comfort with speed and ambiguity. You'd rather ship a strong v1, learn, and iterate than wait for it to be perfect. Shifting priorities and an evolving playbook energize rather than slow you down.

  • Strong judgment and taste. You have a high bar for how a company presents itself, from the story to the words to the visual execution, and can maintain that bar across channels, mediums and activities.

  • The ability to create alignment. You can bring founders, Sales, CS, and Product, and eventually a team of your own, around a clear, consistent narrative.

Bonus Experience

  • Experience shaping an executive or founder voice. You know how to draw out a leader's ideas, sharpen them into a distinct point of view, and turn that voice into content that builds credibility and reach.

  • Brand strategy and visual identity experience. You've helped shape how an early-stage company looks, feels, and shows up in the market, and know how to translate positioning into cohesive visuals.

  • Experience marketing directly to our ICP. You've built messaging, content, or go-to-market programs for institutional investors, consulting firms, AI labs, or similarly sophisticated enterprise audiences.

  • Experience with a two-sided marketplace or expert network. You understand the dynamics of marketing a business where you need to build affinity and engagement on both sides of the network.

Benefits + Perks

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

  • Paid time off policy, along with company holidays

  • Annual company off-sites (Tahoe, Mendocino, Mexico City, San Diego, Park City)

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Paid parental leave (12 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, and birthing parents get 8–10 additional weeks of paid recovery leave)

Pay Transparency Notice

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits.

Pay range: Base salary between $180-$220k, based on seniority and relevant experience plus an additional target 15-20% discretionary bonus.

This is a hybrid role, in our SF or NY office 2-3 times per week.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that some candidates, especially underrepresented groups such as women and people of color, are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Office Hours we believe in building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You could still be the right candidate for this or other roles at Office Hours!

About the role

We're hiring our first dedicated IT Operations Lead to own the systems, devices, and access that everyone at Office Hours relies on. This is a hands-on role covering the full IT surface: end user support, device and fleet management, SaaS and identity administration, office infrastructure, and the technical side of onboarding and off-boarding. You'll also configure access and tooling to align with our security requirements, working closely with Legal and Compliance..

This is a role built for independence. You'll be the first person in this seat, which means you'll set your own priorities, build the processes as you go, and be the person the company relies on to keep everything running.

You'll join a company of roughly 70 people across San Francisco, New York, and remote, with a growing tool stack and infrastructure that needs a real owner.

What you’ll do

  • End user support. Serve as the first point of contact for IT and systems questions across the company. Triage and resolve hardware, software, and access issues, and build the documentation and guidance that helps people self-serve over time, including on how to get real value out of our AI tools.

  • Device and fleet management. Own hardware procurement, deployment, and lifecycle tracking. Manage MDM enrollment and configuration across a distributed Mac fleet, along with inventory and budget.

  • Identity and access management. Administer our identity provider and SSO, manage role-based access across systems, and run regular access reviews.

  • SaaS and vendor management. Administer our tool stack, evaluate and implement new tools, and manage vendor relationships, contracts, renewals, licenses, and seat allocation. Identify consolidation opportunities and reduce redundant spend. Our AI stack sits inside this scope, so expect to administer it and have a view on what we should be using.

  • Office infrastructure. Maintain network and connectivity, printers and peripherals, and conference room and all-hands AV across our San Francisco and New York offices.

  • Onboarding and offboarding execution. Own the technical side of both: hardware setup, account and license provisioning, and access requests for new hires, then account deactivation, access revocation, asset recovery, license reclamation, and data retention for departures.

  • Security operations. Implement and maintain security configurations across our systems, support remediation work, and partner with our security owners to keep access and tooling aligned with our requirements.

  • Process and documentation. Build the runbooks, workflows, and automation that make this function scalable as the company grows.

  • AI tooling and enablement. Own administration of our AI tool stack, including access, licensing, and usage visibility. Help people across the company actually use these tools well through documentation, training, and hands-on support. Bring a clear point of view to evaluations of new AI tools, and advise leadership on adoption, cost, and appropriate use.

What you bring

  • 8 to 12 years in IT operations or systems administration, ideally at a startup with in-person and remote employees

  • Experience as the sole or first IT hire, or equivalent experience operating with a high degree of autonomy

  • Security experience: Hands-on experience owning or supporting security programs and practices, including areas such as access management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, security tooling, and incident response.

  • Fluent, daily use of AI tools in your own work, real opinions about what works and what doesn't, and a knack for teaching others, not just fixing their problems.

  • Strong hands-on administration of Google Workspace, an identity provider such as Okta, and Mac fleet management through an MDM

  • Demonstrated ownership of a modern SaaS stack, including access management, licensing, and cost control

  • Sound judgment about what you handle independently and what you escalate

  • A patient, service-oriented approach with non-technical colleagues

  • Experience configuring security controls against an established framework

  • Multi-site network and AV setup

Bonus Experience

  • Direct experience driving AI adoption across a non-technical population, or advising leadership on AI tooling decisions.

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Monthly wellness and fitness stipend

Full-time offers include base salary, equity, and benefits.
